subject: Activation playbook: stakeholder sync & exception path
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa@acmepayments.com>
Date: 2028-07-22 08:12 -0700
Subject: Activation playbook: stakeholder sync & exception path

Team —

We need a short cross-functional decision today on the final activation timeline for Acme Payments. High-level asks:

- Confirm final rollout date (current target: Aug 6) — engineering has a tentative freeze Aug 1.
- Owners for the enablement artifacts (playbook, runbook, training slots).
- Exception path if SOC2 evidence arrives late — legal/compliance want a clear stop/allow criteria.

I attached a first-draft playbook (activation-playbook-v1.pdf) and an .ics with the proposed training slots. Please reply with: owner + ETA for each artifact and any blockers. If we don't get alignment by EOD PT we'll escalate to execs for a one-week shift.

Attachments: [activation-playbook-v1.pdf (pdf)], [enablement-trainings.ics (calendar)]

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Product Lead, Launch & Enablement
Redwood Inference

To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa@acmepayments.com>
Date: 2028-07-22 10:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation playbook: stakeholder sync & exception path

On Mon, Jul 22, 2028 at 8:12 AM Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We need a short cross-functional decision today on the final activation timeline for Acme Payments. High-level asks:
> 
> - Confirm final rollout date (current target: Aug 6) — engineering has a tentative freeze Aug 1.
> - Owners for the enablement artifacts (playbook, runbook, training slots).
> - Exception path if SOC2 evidence arrives late — legal/compliance want a clear stop/allow criteria.

> I attached a first-draft playbook (activation-playbook-v1.pdf) and an .ics with the proposed training slots. Please reply with: owner + ETA for each artifact and any blockers. If we don't get alignment by EOD PT we'll escalate to execs for a one-week shift.

Quick notes from Enablement/Docs:
- I can own the playbook finalization and delivery to SAs. ETA: July 28 (reasonable) provided engineering confirms final API surface by July 26.
- Runbook (ops runbooks + rollback steps): Laura Bennett can co-own with Ops. Laura — can you confirm capacity?
- Training: I've proposed 3 slots; if those don't work we'll add 2 evening slots. Calendar attached.

Open question: if SOC2 evidence is late, we should have a "soft activation" path limited to test accounts only — legal to sign off. Monica / Vivek, you OK with this conditional ramp?

Attachments referenced: [enablement-trainings.ics], [activation-playbook-v1.pdf]

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa@acmepayments.com>
Date: 2028-07-22 13:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation playbook: stakeholder sync & exception path

Thanks — quick operational read:
- I can mark Compliance as "ready to review" if the SOC2 evidence file is uploaded by COB July 25. If it's later, we'll need the exception form (SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx) filled and formal signoff from Legal.
- I support a soft activation to test accounts only for two weeks, but two conditions: (1) logging + audit retention must be on; (2) customer data must be routed to dedicated tenancy. Both are configured but we need Ops confirmation — Laura?

Action items:
- Marissa: own playbook final (ETA July 28) — include short checklist for SOC2 gating.
- Laura: confirm ops tenancy + logging by July 25.
- Aditya: consolidate decisions and loop in Vivek if exec alignment needed.

Attachments: [SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx]

—Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-22 15:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation playbook: stakeholder sync & exception path

Folks —

Quick flag from the execs: CFO and CRO prefer not to proceed with a public activation if the SOC2 artifacts are not complete. They will accept a one-week delay (move to Aug 13) rather than a soft-test-only activation unless Legal signs the exception.

If we can get the SOC2 evidence and the filled exception form (Monica's template) by COB July 25, they will greenlight Aug 6. Otherwise expect an ask to shift to Aug 13. Please call out any business impact immediately — Marissa, will the training slots slip if we delay?

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lisa Chen <lisa@acmepayments.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmepayments.com>
Date: 2028-07-22 16:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation playbook: stakeholder sync & exception path

Thanks all — decision summary:

- Target activation: Aug 6 (hold) with a contingency shift to Aug 13 if SOC2 evidence + exception form not in by COB July 25.
- Owners: Marissa (playbook final, ETA July 28), Laura (ops tenancy & logging confirm by July 25), Monica (compliance review + exception form).
- Training: Marissa to confirm whether proposed slots can be preserved if we shift one week — update by EOD July 23.

I will draft a short exec note to the CFO/CRO this evening outlining the gating criteria and the recommended contingency. Lisa — we'll keep you posted; procurement team, please expect a potential one-week timing move.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c/activation-playbook, HubSpot: 987654321

Attachments: [activation-playbook-v1.pdf], [SOC2-evidence-request.xlsx]

-Aditya
